Platform-dependent TreePPL self-contained installation

Source: R/utils.R
tp_installing_treeppl.Rd

tp_installing_treeppl() looks for the tpplc compiler associated with the package and, if it is not found, downloads and unpacks it.

Usage

tp_installing_treeppl(download = TRUE, keep_previous = FALSE)

Arguments

download

Logical. Download the associated tpplc version if it is not present locally.

keep_previous

Logical. Keep previously downloaded tpplc versions instead of deleting them before the new download.

Value

The path to the TreePPL compiler.

Details

The search order is:

  1. the TPPLC environment variable;

  2. on Windows, a manual installation of tpplc (no self-contained build is available);

  3. an already unpacked copy in /tmp;

  4. a downloaded tarball in the treeppl directory next to the local treepplr installation (downloaded first if download = TRUE).
